# ubiops_deployment (Resource)

Manages a UbiOps deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ubiops_deployment" "example" {
  project_name = "my-project"
  name         = "my-deployment"
  description  = "An example deployment"
  input_type   = "structured"
  output_type  = "structured"

  input_fields = [
    {
      name      = "input"
      data_type = "string"
    }
  ]

  output_fields = [
    {
      name      = "output"
      data_type = "string"
    }
  ]

  labels = {
    environment = "production"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the deployment
- `project_name` (String) The name of the project this deployment belongs to.

### Optional

- `default_version` (String) Default version of the deployment. If it does not have a default version, it is not set. Set this to promote a version to receive traffic without recreating the deployment — the standard blue/green pattern for zero-downtime version rollouts and rollbacks.
- `description` (String) Description of the deployment
- `input_fields` (Attributes List) The list of deployment input fields containing name and data_type. It is empty in case of plain input type deployments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--input_fields))
- `input_type` (String) Type of the input of the deployment
- `labels` (Map of String) Dictionary containing key/value pairs where key indicates the label and value is the corresponding value of that label
- `output_fields` (Attributes List) The list of deployment output fields containing name and data_type. It is empty in case of plain output type deployments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--output_fields))
- `output_type` (String) Type of the output of the deployment
- `supports_request_format` (Boolean) Whether the deployment supports UbiOps's structured request format (queuing, autoscaling, scheduled requests). false is required for Bring Your Own Docker deployments that are standalone applications (e.g. a Jupyter server, or a raw HTTP service like litellm-gateway) - the deployment's environment must have a matching supports_request_format value, or version creation fails with "Given environment is not supported for the deployment" (confirmed live 2026-07-18). Deployments with this set to false have no autoscaling - a fixed instance count only.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) The date when the deployment was created
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the deployment (UUID)
- `last_updated` (String) The date when the deployment was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--input_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `input_fields`

Required:

- `data_type` (String) The data type of the field.
- `name` (String) The name of the field.


<a id="nestedatt--output_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `output_fields`

Required:

- `data_type` (String) The data type of the field.
- `name` (String) The name of the field.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import ubiops_deployment.example my-project/my-deployment
```
